Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Fei et al PNAS 2007 \[BM3\]

**reproduced** · `neon_fcc_fei_2007_bm3_1` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/neon_fcc.md#record-neon_fcc_fei_2007_bm3_1)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Conditional equal-pressure-weight joint PVT agreement within published parameter widths; source confidence and covariance are unspecified.

- Fei original new observations, paired Pt/Au volumes, full source selection, weights, covariance and unrounded inputs not recovered. Cold unweighted fits can agree with individual published error widths without reproducing the original regression or joint uncertainty region. Only prior-table source errors permit source-error-weighted comparisons. Hot source errors and temperature errors are absent; no source-error-weighted hot fit is possible. Effective error weights use slopes of the published model, ignore shared calibration correlations and retain each table's original pressure/volume errors. Finger 293 K pressures are preserved on the original Piermarini scale; Fei explicitly recalibrates Hemley only. Assigning Finger to 300 K is a documented diagnostic choice. Curve agreement validates an equation/normalization at plotted conditions; it establishes neither exact original-regression recovery nor absolute pressure accuracy. Dewaele (2008) note29 discusses a 0 K reinterpretation and contains a self-referential citation typo. Fei Eq.3 and the Figure5 cold curve remain the authority for the retained 300 K subtraction. Published q error is 0.3; source confidence level and covariance are unspecified. No thermal diagnostic replaces published q=0.6.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** neon\_fei\_2007\_figure5\_digitized; neon\_hemley\_1989\_table1\_fei\_recalculated; neon\_finger\_1981\_table1; neon\_fei\_2007\_figure5\_1000k\_digitized
- **Observations:** 54
- **Fit kind:** diagnostic\_joint\_pvt
- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime; q
- **Fixed parameters:**
    - **V0:** 88.967
    - **Gamma0:** 2.05
    - **Theta0:** 75.1
